description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific Trello label by its ID, allowing selection of specific fields to return.

fields.description: Fields to return for the label. Allowed: `color`, `idBoard`, `name`.
fields.title: Fields

idLabel.description: The unique identifier of the Trello label to retrieve.
idLabel.title: Id Label

name: get_labels_by_id_label

color.description: The color of the label (e.g., 'green', 'yellow', 'red', 'blue', 'purple', 'orange', 'black', 'sky', 'pink', 'lime', or null for no color).
color.title: Color

id.description: The unique identifier of the label.
id.title: Id

idBoard.description: The ID of the board the label belongs to.
idBoard.title: Id Board

idOrganization.description: The ID of the organization (workspace) the label belongs to.
idOrganization.title: Id Organization

nodeId.description: The ARI (Atlassian Resource Identifier) node ID of the label.

uses.description: The number of cards using this label.
